item.title: Secure Multi-Tenant AI Video Editing, Distribution, and Project Manager Platform
item.description:
250-750 USD | Title: Senior engineer (Claude Code + security) to turn our AI video-editing factory into a secure, multi-client product
About us We’re a media distribution brand that makes a lot of short vertical video ads for TikTok and Instagram. Over the last few months we built an in-house AI “creative factory” with Claude Code. It does the work of a video editor: it picks up tasks from our project board and edits the raw creator footage into a finished ad. A human reviews and approves, and only then is the final file rendered and delivered.
It works, but it’s a prototype: it runs on one Mac, the keys sit in a .env file, and it’s built for one company. We want an engineer to make it professional, secure and repeatable so it can run for several businesses, each with its own brand, accounts and data.
What exists today
Pipeline: Node 22 server with SQLite. Stations are Intake → Edit → QA → Human review → Render → Delivery. A live “factory floor” web UI shows the jobs moving between stations. Workers: Python plus ffmpeg. Transcription (ElevenLabs Scribe), an assembly cut (best take of each line, retakes and dead air removed), and an LLM-planned main edit (captions, overlays, product shots, zooms) through OpenRouter (Claude, plus Gemini as a QA judge). Editor: each ad is an editable timeline project in an open-source web video editor (a customised OpenFilm Studio). The reviewer can open each timeline, change it and approve it. Integrations: the Asana API (task pickup, custom fields), the Frame.io V4 API (delivery) and Google Drive (footage). Guardrails: Claude Code hooks, subagents and skills, plus spend caps per day and per job.
What we want built
A cloud deployment. Everything runs on a server: footage never touches a laptop, and nothing is rendered until a human approves. A desktop workstation app for Mac. It’s a thin client: several jobs open at once, each in its own timeline window, all streamed from the cloud. Multi-tenancy. Each business gets its own isolated workspace: data, footage, brand kit, API connections, spend limits and users. Repeatable onboarding. Adding a new business should be config, not code: connect Asana, Drive and Frame.io, upload brand assets, set the rules. Production quality: CI, tests, monitoring, logs, backups and documentation.
Must-haves
Strong, hands-on Claude Code experience: CLAUDE.md, subagents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and ideally the Claude Agent SDK and headless runs. Please show real examples. Cybersecurity, applied. We will test you on: secrets management and least-privilege service accounts tenant isolation (one client can never see another client’s footage or keys) zero-trust access to internal tools (no exposed admin ports) webhook signature checks prompt-injection defence: our agents read task text, scripts and comments, which are untrusted input supply-chain hygiene (pinned dependencies) and audit logs Node.js and Python in production, Linux servers, ffmpeg or other media-pipeline experience. Clear written English and async communication.
Nice to have
Swift or desktop-app experience (Tauri or native macOS) Experience with video at scale (proxies, streaming, GPU or headless rendering) Hetzner, Modal, AWS, or Cloudflare (Access/Tunnel) SOC 2-style thinking: access reviews, data retention, incident response
How to apply (answers without these will be skipped)
Start your bid with the word “VSRL”. Describe a Claude Code hook, subagent or MCP server you’ve built, and what it did. In 3–5 sentences: how would you stop an AI agent from following instructions hidden in a client’s task description? How would you isolate tenants’ files and API keys on a shared server? Links to relevant work (GitHub, case studies).
Budget: $300 / Month (negotiable) · Longterm job - at least for the next 6 months. We’ll share the full architecture under an NDA after an interview. Contract under USA cybersecurity and copyright laws.

item.title: AWS Website Migration & SEO Preservation
item.description:

Project Overview We are looking for an experienced Website Migration Specialist / AWS Cloud Architect to manage a website migration and infrastructure restructuring project.
Our existing website, sanaco.com.sa, is currently hosted on Amazon AWS Lightsail. The website has a database exceeding 150 GB and contains substantial business content, products, categories and SEO-optimised pages.
Management has decided to use sana.com.sa for the existing website content and business activities, while retaining sanaco.com.sa for a different business purpose with separate content and functionality.
We need an experienced professional to plan and execute this migration without losing existing website data, SEO value, organic search visibility or business functionality.
Project Objectives Migrate the existing website from sanaco.com.sa to sana.com.sa. Preserve all existing products, categories, website content, images and relevant database records. Protect the SEO investment made on 268 optimised product pages. Implement appropriate 301 redirects from the old domain to the new domain. Retain sanaco.com.sa and prepare it for a completely different website and business purpose. Establish an efficient, secure and scalable AWS hosting architecture. Minimise website downtime and avoid data loss during migration. Scope of Work 1. Existing Website and Infrastructure Audit Analyse the existing website architecture. Review the AWS Lightsail hosting environment. Identify the website technology, programming language and database engine. Audit the existing database (150+ GB). Analyse website files, media storage, plugins and integrations. Identify unnecessary database records and technical issues. Evaluate the existing server's performance and resource utilisation. 2. Website Migration to sana.com.sa Create the new production environment for sana.com.sa. Migrate the existing website application and required files. Migrate the database and associated media. Preserve products, categories, attributes, variations and relevant business records. Preserve customer and historical transaction data where required. Configure domain DNS, SSL and server settings. Test all website functionalities before launch. 3. SEO Preservation and Migration SEO preservation is a critical requirement of this project.
We have already completed SEO optimisation for 268 products on sanaco.com.sa.
The selected freelancer must ensure:
Preservation of existing product URLs wherever possible. Migration of all SEO titles and meta descriptions. Preservation of product descriptions and headings. Preservation of image ALT tags and relevant image assets. Preservation of structured data and schema markup. Correct canonical tag configuration. Updated internal linking structure. Updated XML sitemap. Updated robots.txt configuration. Individual 301 redirects from old URLs to corresponding new URLs. No unnecessary redirect chains or redirect loops. Verification of Google Search Console and indexing configuration. All 268 SEO-optimised products must be checked after migration.
Important: Redirecting all old URLs to the new homepage will not be accepted. Redirects must point to relevant equivalent pages.
4. Repurposing sanaco.com.sa After migrating the existing website to sana.com.sa:
sanaco.com.sa must remain operational. The domain will be used for a different business purpose. The new website must have an independent application and content structure. The new website must have a separate database. Historical URLs from the old website must continue to redirect appropriately to their corresponding pages on sana.com.sa. The new website must not interfere with the existing SEO migration strategy. 5. AWS Infrastructure and Database Optimisation We are open to recommendations regarding the best AWS architecture.
Potential technologies include:
AWS Lightsail Amazon EC2 Amazon RDS Amazon S3 Amazon CloudFront AWS Route 53 AWS Backup Amazon CloudWatch The freelancer should recommend whether to:
Retain and optimise the existing Lightsail infrastructure. Move to EC2 and RDS. Implement another cost-effective AWS architecture. The two websites should have independent applications and databases, even if they share appropriate AWS infrastructure.
The proposed solution must consider security, scalability, performance, backup and disaster recovery.
6. Testing and Quality Assurance Before final deployment, the freelancer must verify:
All 268 SEO product pages. Product images and media files. Product categories and variations. Website navigation and internal links. Forms and integrations. Customer accounts and historical records where applicable. Database integrity. SSL certificates. Website loading speed. Mobile responsiveness. HTTP status codes and redirects. Google indexing and sitemap configuration. 7. Post-Migration Support The freelancer should provide post-launch technical support to resolve migration-related issues.
We also require documentation of:
New AWS architecture. Database migration procedure. Website deployment process. Backup and recovery procedures. DNS and domain configuration. Redirect mapping. Technical handover documentation. Expected Deliverables Technical audit report of the existing website. Recommended AWS infrastructure architecture. Fully migrated website on sana.com.sa. Independent website infrastructure for sanaco.com.sa. Migrated database and website files. SEO migration and URL redirect mapping. Verification report for all 268 SEO-optimised products. Performance and security testing report. AWS configuration and technical documentation. Post-migration support. Required Freelancer Skills We are looking for a professional with proven experience in:
AWS Lightsail. Amazon EC2 and RDS. MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL, as applicable. Large database migrations (100 GB+). Website domain migrations. SEO migration and 301 redirects. Google Search Console. Website performance optimisation. Cloud infrastructure and server administration. Database backup and disaster recovery. Experience with complex production website migrations is highly preferred.
Important Project Requirements Experience with large databases is mandatory. SEO migration experience is essential. The freelancer must provide a clear migration strategy before implementation. Full backups must be taken before any production changes. The migration must be tested in a staging environment. No existing website data should be deleted without approval. Website downtime should be kept to a minimum. All website and infrastructure credentials must be handled securely. All project work and documentation must be handed over upon completion. What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide the following information when submitting your bid:
Describe your experience migrating websites with databases exceeding 100 GB. Have you previously migrated websites between two domains while preserving SEO rankings? What AWS architecture would you recommend for this project? How would you handle the migration of the 150+ GB database? How would you preserve the SEO value of 268 optimised product pages? What is your estimated project timeline? What is your estimated total project cost? What post-migration support do you provide? We prefer freelancers who can demonstrate previous successful projects involving AWS infrastructure, large database migration and SEO-preserving domain migration.

## 1. Customer Shopping Experience
- Amazon-style homepage and responsive storefront. - Advanced product search, filters, categories, and sorting. - Detailed product pages with images, specifications, pricing, and availability. - Customer registration, login, and account management. - Wishlists and saved products. - Shopping cart and secure Stripe checkout. - Supported card and digital-wallet payments through Stripe. - Customer order history and order-status dashboard. - Product reviews and ratings. - Promotional pricing and discount functionality. - Inventory and price revalidation before order submission.
## 2. Supplier and Product Integration
- Spark Shipping API v1 integration. - Initial supplier integration with Keystone Automotive. - Automated product catalog synchronization. - Product inventory and pricing updates. - Lowest-cost eligible supplier selection with administrative override. - Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) compliance. - Configurable supplier integrations. - Automated order submission to supported suppliers. - Split-shipment support when multiple suppliers fulfill an order.

Some Spark Shipping products may not include images.
The developer must implement a process to match these products with images and descriptions maintained by Eagle Vision Edge LLC.
Matching should use reliable product identifiers, including SKU, manufacturer part number, brand, and product attributes. Administrators must be able to review uncertain matches.
## 3. ZIP Code-Based Shipping Calculation
The platform must calculate shipping costs based on:
- Customer destination ZIP code. - Supplier or warehouse origin ZIP code. - Product weight and dimensions. - Shipping method and available carrier rates. - Multiple suppliers and split shipments.
Customers must see the calculated shipping cost before completing payment.
The system must recalculate shipping charges when delivery details change.
If live carrier rates are unavailable, an approved configurable rate table must be supported.
## 4. Order Tracking and Google Maps
Customers must be able to track orders from purchase through delivery.
Required functionality includes:
- Order confirmation and processing status. - Supplier shipment status and tracking number. - Carrier tracking integration. - Google Maps API visualization when shipment-location data is available. - Estimated delivery information where supported. - Tracking of multiple shipments for one order. - Email and SMS shipment notifications.
Google Maps must not be represented as a source of live carrier GPS data unless the carrier provides that information.
## 5. Multi-Tenant Architecture
The platform must support multiple independent storefronts.
Requirements include:
- Tenant-specific storefront configuration. - Tenant data isolation. - Tenant-specific product catalogs and settings. - Administrative controls for tenant management. - Secure authentication and role-based access. - Audit logs and activity tracking.
## 6. Administrative Dashboard
Provide administrative functionality for:
- Product and catalog management. - Supplier integration configuration. - Inventory and pricing management. - Order management and fulfillment monitoring. - Customer management. - Shipment tracking. - Promotions and discounts. - User permissions and audit logs. - Reporting and operational analytics.
## 7. Mandatory Technology Stack
The developer must use:
- **Frontend:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. - **Backend:** Java Spring Boot. - **Database:** PostgreSQL or MySQL. - **Payments:** Stripe. - **Supplier Integration:** Spark Shipping API v1. - **Maps:** Google Maps API. - **Source Control:** Private Git repository controlled by Eagle Vision Edge LLC.
Technology substitutions require prior written approval.
## 8. Independent Development and UAT Environment
Spark Shipping does not provide a general-purpose sandbox for this project.
The developer must establish a separate development and UAT environment that includes:
- Mock Spark Shipping API services. - Simulated product catalogs and inventory. - Test pricing and supplier selection. - Simulated order submission and shipment tracking. - Stripe test-mode payments. - Test scenarios for missing product images. - ZIP-code shipping calculation tests. - Multi-tenant security and data-isolation testing. - End-to-end checkout and order lifecycle tests.
Testing must not accidentally create real supplier orders or production charges.
## 9. Milestones and Payments

Review existing code, architecture, integration requirements, and development environment.
**Phase 2 — $400: Catalog and Storefront Integration**
Complete agreed storefront functionality, supplier catalog integration, product synchronization, and image-matching workflows.

Complete Stripe checkout, shipping cost calculation, order processing, supplier fulfillment integration, and tracking workflows.
**Phase 4 — $500: Full Testing, UAT, and Handover**

**Total Fixed Budget: $1,600 USD**
Milestone funds may be secured through Freelancer.com, but payment will be released only after the corresponding work is completed, tested, delivered, and accepted in writing.
## 10. Ownership and Final Acceptance
All development must take place in an Eagle Vision Edge LLC-controlled private repository.
Existing client intellectual property remains protected. Project-specific deliverables must be transferred in accordance with the signed agreement.
The final product must materially match the approved prototype and satisfy all agreed functional requirements.
